Regulatory Notice 99-21

FINRA Amends Rules to Address Test Options

Notice Type
Rule Amendment
Suggested Routing
Compliance
Legal

Summary

FINRA has adopted amendments to address test options. Download the notice (PDF)

Effective Date

The amendments become effective January 1, 2027.

Background and Discussion

Members must maintain written supervisory procedures for test options.

  • Members must retain records of each transaction for six years.

Related notices: 98-01
